instrument: Contract with Shade N' Net funded by Compass Datacenters donation (June 16, 2026, item 6.1)
summary: Council authorized a contract for a basketball court shade structure at the Northwest Valley YMCA, funded through a private donation from Compass Datacenters of up to $110,573.12, 5-2.
text: Consideration and action to authorize the City Manager to enter into a contract with Shade N' Net to complete the outdoor basketball court shade structure installation at the Northwest Valley YMCA, funded through a private donation from Compass Datacenters for an amount not to exceed $110,573.12, and authorize the Finance Department to make any necessary transfers.

source.citation: City of El Mirage, Regular City Council Meeting Results, June 16, 2026

notes: Vote: Mayor Hermosillo/Dorcey, 5/2 (Nay: Eldridge, Gentry). Mechanism 'incentive' used for a developer community-benefit donation; no enum fits exactly. Sequence (dates only): June 16 donation; Aug 17 final plat and development agreement. No inference drawn.
confidence_note: Reported detail that the city owns the site and oversees construction is not in this document.
